title: Working with Text: Strings and f-strings

ai_pair_moment.flaw: The AI left out the f before the opening quotation mark and predicted 'Sandwich            6.00'. Without the f, the curly brackets are plain text, so Python printed '{item:<16}{price:>8.2f}' with no error. Adding the f fixes it.

changes: Indexing is taught for single characters only; slicing is left to Chapter 11, where it is taught with lists, to keep this chapter focused.
Added len() as a small extra, because counting characters is needed to understand indexes and column widths.
Used '=' as the fill character for the receipt title, so the expected output has no invisible trailing spaces.
The AI improve-stage example uses decimal prices, because a precision without a type raises an error for whole numbers.
outstanding_issues: The tracebacks in Common mistakes show the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path to the file appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Kokoro bm_lewis). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the PRONOUNCE list in tools/voice.py.
